answer: Each identity holds one grove of violet leaves: a leaf is a job verified by a distinct outside sponsor, key-signed, never reusable for another leaf or head. Five leaves are needed to claim, each renewed by a job every epoch, so ten heads need fifty jobs. The comet seed is the prior emission hash, published before sampling; a sampled leaf survives only if its key signs a challenge and its receipt verifies. Groves stake leaves jointly in advance, so one failed leaf forfeits all five; wilted leaves lose standing but stay on record for audit, and a grove starts at zero.
